notes: US store title: 'Women's Men's & Kids Clothing & Accessories | Cotton On USA'. No short positioning line found, so known_for is empty.
Site banner on the US store: 'Free delivery on orders $75+'. Standard rate not stated.

Returns page: 'No expiration on returns!': eligible items can be returned at any time with proof of purchase, in original condition; return shipping free within the country of purchase; original delivery fees not refunded on change-of-mind returns. returns_days left empty because there is no day limit.
Size guide: women's US 0–20 (3XS–5XL). Jeans menu has Petite Jeans and Curvy Fit Jeans; petite tiles say 'Shorter Front Rise & Inseam'; some curvy tiles say 'Gap-proof Waist'.
Wikipedia: Cotton On Group founded 1991 by Nigel Austin, HQ Geelong, Australia, private company.
